steps.page: What you asked for, and what you got
steps.intro: Everything from your round-3 answers, built. Each row stands unless you open its pencil. Click a picture to open it large; drag on it to comment on a part.

steps.path: Any deck link I send you
steps.headline: What you asked for, and what you got

calls.call: Every list row has one pencil. It opens one box for a change, a question or a stray thought.
calls.why: "Change this" and "More context" are gone.
calls.decided: "simplify down to a single pencil/edit icon on each of these rows that opens the comment box"

calls.call: "All fine" is gone. A list you leave untouched is accepted when you press Next page.
calls.why: A list on a page you never opened stays unanswered.
calls.decided: "i honestly dont even know if we need it, could probably integrate with the next page button"

calls.call: Row pictures are small, sit at the right, and open large inside the deck.
calls.why: No more empty space beside a tall picture, and no new browser tab.
calls.decided: "introduces a lot of deadspace … opens it in a separate tab, which is strange"

calls.call: A Notes button in the header, on every page, for comments tied to no question.
calls.why: A blue dot shows when it holds something. It reaches me first, above your answers.
calls.decided: "there is no additional/separate notes button for me to leave misc/unrelated comments"

calls.call: Voice now follows YouCoded's own method: words appear about three times a second, and it stops by itself after two seconds of quiet.
calls.why: Four bars and a clock show inside the box while it listens.
calls.decided: "make this work much more like how it actually works in youcoded, including showing my words as i speak"

calls.call: A row can be an editable box of on-screen wording, already filled in, with a picture of where it appears.
calls.why: Page 4 of this deck has real ones to try.
calls.decided: "should be pre-filled with the suggested or existing copy"

calls.call: A page showing every changed screen together, before beside after.
calls.why: It is the next page of this deck.
calls.decided: "a way to see all new screens and visual changes together is still useful"

calls.call: Rows are soft boxes with a small gap, and text boxes look like YouCoded's message box.
calls.why: Taken from the app's design guide: boxed rows, no lines across a card, quick action at the top right.
calls.decided: "can be smarter and better utilize youcoded design principles"

steps.intro: What changed that has no screen.

steps.path: Any deck link I send you
steps.headline: How voice works now

calls.call: While you talk, the helper listens only to the sentence still in progress, about three times a second.
calls.why: Before, it re-listened to the whole recording once a second, so words came in slow lumps and got slower.

calls.call: After a pause of about a second, once you have spoken five seconds, that sentence is closed and never re-heard.
calls.why: This keeps it fast however long you talk. YouCoded uses the same numbers.

calls.call: If you talk fifteen seconds without a pause, it closes the sentence at the quietest recent moment.
calls.why: A cut in the middle of a word would be heard as two wrong words.

calls.call: Two seconds of quiet after you have said something stops the microphone.
calls.why: A microphone opened in a silent room does not close at once.

calls.call: Leaving a page saves every untouched list on it as accepted.
calls.why: This replaces the "All fine" button.

steps.intro: Things you could notice that I decided without asking. The boxes are real deck wording: retype any.

steps.path: Any deck link I send you
steps.headline: Choices I made

calls.call: Speaking into an untouched wording box replaces its text. Everywhere else, speech is added after what is typed.
calls.why: Adding to my suggested wording would rarely be what you want.

calls.call: Drawing a rectangle on a large picture closes the large view and puts you in that rectangle's comment box.
calls.why: The comment boxes live on the page, under the list.

calls.call: Lists no longer say "List 1 of 3" above their title.
calls.why: You approved dropping "Question" from things that are not questions.

calls.call: Old picture decks (one screenshot per step) keep their Prev and Next in the header.
calls.why: Only decks of scrolling pages got the new foot buttons, to avoid changing two layouts at once.

calls.call: Title of the Notes panel
calls.why: Shown when you press Notes.

calls.call: Grey hint inside the Notes box
calls.why: Shown until you type.
calls.wording: Anything not tied to one question — about this deck, or the work as a whole

calls.call: Grey hint inside a row's comment box
calls.why: Shown after you press a pencil.
calls.wording: Your comment, or what it should be instead

calls.call: Link under a wording box you changed
calls.why: Puts my text back.

calls.call: Line under a picture opened large
calls.why: Shown at the bottom of the screen.
calls.wording: Drag across any part to comment on it · click anywhere or press Esc to close

steps.intro: What I ran, what it showed, and what only you can judge.

steps.path: Any deck link I send you
steps.headline: Checks I ran, and what they showed

calls.call: All 354 automatic checks of the deck tool.
calls.why: Run after the last change. One old check was unreliable and is fixed.

calls.call: A test browser pressed a pencil, retyped a wording box, opened and closed a large picture, and wrote a note. The saved file held all of it.
calls.why: Now a permanent automatic check.

calls.call: Voice, fed a recording in place of the microphone: words reached the box as they were spoken, and it stopped by itself after the quiet.
calls.why: The picture shows it mid-sentence.

calls.call: Voice with your real voice and microphone.
calls.why: I do not record your microphone. A recording is not the same as a person pausing and restarting.

calls.call: The text box changing shape while listening.
calls.why: I found one real cause: the box was 8 pixels wider than its row. Fixed, but I never saw what you saw.

steps.path: Any deck link I send you
steps.headline: Left for you to try

calls.call: Press a pencil, press the microphone, say two sentences with a pause, then stay quiet.
calls.why: You should see words as you speak, bars moving, and it stopping by itself.

calls.call: Open a picture large and drag a rectangle on it.
calls.why: It should close and put you in a numbered comment box.

calls.call: Retype one wording box on page 4, then press "Put back the original".
calls.why: The box should return to my text.

steps.intro: The instructions every future chat will follow, as I have now written them, and one question.

steps.path: The rule files every YouCoded chat reads
steps.headline: The rules I wrote from your answers

calls.call: Asked as questions, early: the main paths a person takes, a screen's big-picture layout, how parts affect each other, anything removed, money, privacy.
calls.why: Your round-2 words, nearly verbatim.

calls.call: Listed for you to change, in the walkthrough: everything else you could notice. Wording, what happens when something fails, defaults, sizes, order.
calls.why: When unsure, a chat lists it rather than deciding silently.

calls.call: Never shown: only what cannot be detected by using the app.
calls.why: Your objection was that "build details" was too vague.

calls.call: A walkthrough has five pages: what you asked for, every changed screen, behind the scenes, choices I made, checks.
calls.why: Shown before building with drawings, and again after with screenshots.

calls.call: Work is finished when you go through the after-walkthrough and change nothing. Contract and acceptance decks are retired.
calls.why: Work already under a signed contract finishes under it.

calls.call: Outside reviewers are no longer fixed steps. A chat suggests checks before building, you edit the list, and each result comes back with proof.
calls.why: Your answer: you steer the checks.
